title: Choose Carnet's twist
question: Five signature twists, from the smallest to the biggest. Each picture is a working prototype drawn on today's board with Carnet's real font, colours, icons and emblems. Every option keeps your layout, behaviour, Signika, the sheets and the pebbles. Pick one, or steer (for example: Jazz plus the stamp).

options.label: Le tampon
options.lineage: French office rubber stamps, the one Carnet already presses on finished links
options.thesis: A checklist ticked to the end gets the stamp links already get, in its own verb: BOUCLÉE for a suitcase, ACHETÉ for shopping, FAIT otherwise.
materials: a verb per kind of list
the press: 1.3 to 1 at full ink
options.viewport: Board as today; a finished list shows its count and its stamp in a row of its own. Ticking the last item stamps the open note, with Annuler on the slip.
options.risk: Lives on completion, not at rest: a week with nothing finished looks like today.
options.case: Grows the moment you already like best, with no new colour and no new form.

options.label: Le timbre
options.lineage: Philately and the carnet de voyage: perforated stamps, postmarks, un carnet de timbres
options.thesis: Every link Claude keeps is a stamp glued into its collection: the picture perforated, the snip cutting along the perforation, done as the postmark that cancels it.
materials: perforated stamp paper around each picture
the perforation as the snip's cut line
options.viewport: Board: a collection card shows its links as little stamps; a shared link is cut along a perforation and lands as a stamp (Collé dans Films & séries). Collection: every picture a stamp, done ones postmarked.
options.risk: The notes board barely changes, and the perforated edge must stay crisp and regular or it turns scrapbook.
options.case: Makes the half Keep does not have (links read by Claude) unmistakable.

options.label: Jazz
options.lineage: Matisse's Jazz (1947): plates of flat gouache colour, one cut-out figure on each
options.thesis: The emblems stop whispering: each collection becomes a plate of its full pigment with its cut-out in cream paper, small on the board, full-bleed at the head of its page.
materials: flat gouache plates in each collection's pigment
cream cut-outs, large and cropped by the edge
options.viewport: Board: the chips become a row of colour plates and a pinned collection is a small plate, its star cut big and cropped. Mode: a bordeaux head with a giant cream flower, the add-link strip straddling its edge; a chip unfolds into that head.
options.risk: Pigment leaves the cut-outs for whole plates (a rule bends), and seven collections make a loud row; colour stays on collections, never on notes.
options.case: Amplifies what Carnet already owns since you picked the cut-outs, and it shows on a still screen.

options.label: Le cahier
options.lineage: The French school cahier: Seyès grands carreaux and the red margin
options.thesis: The board is a page of a French cahier: faint grands carreaux under every sheet, one red margin line, and a Seyès paper a note can take, its text sitting on the big lines.
options.viewport: Board: the cards rest on a ruled page, the red margin along the left edge. Editor: a note on Seyès paper, margin at 42, every line on a big line.
options.risk: Unmistakably French but school-ish; the ruling has to stay faint or a hundred notes on a grid get busy, and it competes with a note's own dots or lines.
options.case: The most culturally specific: no other notes app could wear it.

options.label: La couverture
options.lineage: Clothbound notebooks, and a family shelf: Carnet, Agenda, Album, Classeur, Bonsai, each in its own cloth
options.thesis: Carnet is held in a cloth cover: the bottom bar, the drawer and the slip are cobalt bookcloth with a fine weave, and everything you write stays cream paper.
materials: cobalt bookcloth with a fine weave
cream foil emblems inside the cover
a cloth to choose: Cobalt, Bordeaux, Sarcelle, Moutarde, Charbon
options.viewport: Board: a cobalt cloth band at the foot holding the bar and the matcha pebble. Drawer: the inside of the cover, foil emblems, the mark debossed. Réglages: choose your cloth.
options.risk: A coloured band on every screen and a coloured drawer is a lot of colour for a calm app; chrome leaves paper, terracotta and matcha.
options.case: The strongest brand move, and it scales to the whole family of apps.
